description: Changes the user's Deal Desk profit settings and/or confirms them for this session. minProfit (USD, null = none), minRoiPct (0–200, default 10), feePct (selling fee %, 0–50, default 13.25), orderFee (USD per order, default 0.40), shipping (USD shipping & supplies, default 5), offerPct (opening offer as % of max buy, 50–100, default 90). Pass confirmFees true once the user has confirmed the selling costs shown by open_deal_desk. If the result has alerts, show them to the user before anything else.

confirmFees.description: True when the user confirmed the selling costs for this session.

minProfit.description: Minimum net profit per deal in USD; null removes it.

offerPct.description: Opening offer as a percent of max buy.

shipping.description: Shipping & supplies per sale in USD.

name: update_deal_desk_settings
title: Deal Desk settings
